name: Carbocisteine
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Excess viscous mucus (adjunct; including chronic obstructive airways disease)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 2,250 mg/day in divided doses to start (two 375 mg capsules three times daily); reduce to 1,500 mg/day in divided doses after response

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that can cause gastrointestinal bleeding (NSAIDs, anticoagulants, corticosteroids)
key_interactions.action: Use with caution; stop carbocisteine if bleeding occurs.

serious: Stevens-Johnson syndrome, erythema multiforme, bullous dermatitis (isolated)

sources.citation: Key Pharmaceuticals Ltd.. (2020). Carbocisteine 375 mg capsules, hard [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA0343/008/001; text revised not stated (first authorized March 6, 2020)]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).

draft_notes: The NSAID/anticoagulant row comes from SmPC 4.4 (caution with drugs causing GI bleeding); 4.5 lists no interactions.
